JI Deputy Emir Liaquat Baloch delivered the update following the 10th round of talks between a government committee and a JI delegation in Islamabad. Baloch warned, however, that the party remains prepared to resume its long march if negotiations fail to produce a concrete resolution regarding its core demand to abolish the petroleum levy.

During the discussions, both sides agreed on the necessity of extending relief measures to low-income households, with the government confirming it would consult the International Monetary Fund (IMF) regarding the continuity of such support. JI proposed expanding the relief scope to encompass the agricultural sector and vehicles with engines up to 1,000cc. While the government acknowledged that JI's demand to scrap the petroleum levy was legitimate, it noted it needs to address revenue requirements and will share a framework for gradually reducing the levy following IMF consultations.

The talks featured high-level officials, including Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar, Prime Minister’s Adviser Rana Sanaullah, and Special Assistant Tariq Bajwa. DPM Dar praised the constructive atmosphere and emphasized the government's commitment to assisting ordinary households. Further consultations are scheduled for Wednesday or Thursday, with a final decision expected during a prospective meeting between Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif and JI chief Hafiz Naeemur Rehman.

This dialogue stems from months of intense JI protests, sit-ins, and a previously suspended long march that began in September to contest high fuel prices, inflation, and tax burdens. JI claims its pressure has already halted price hikes and secured significant relief per litre on petrol and diesel, highlighting that the ongoing negotiations represent the culmination of their political campaign to lower public production costs and economic strain.

stories.title: وفاقی وزیر علی پرویز ملک سستی ایل این جی کے حصول کیلئے قطر پہنچ گئے
stories.summary:
وفاقی وزیر علی پرویز ملک ایک اعلیٰ سطحی وفد کے ہمراہ قطر کے دارالحکومت پہنچ چکے ہیں۔ اس دورے کا مقصد سردیوں کے موسم کے دوران ملک میں مائع قدرتی گیس یعنی ایل این جی کی فراہمی کو یقینی بنانا اور مہنگے اسپاٹ کارگوز کے متبادل کے طور پر قطر سے نسبتاً کم نرخوں پر گیس کے حصول کے لیے بات چیت کرنا ہے۔

پیٹرولیم ڈویژن کے حکام کے مطابق موجودہ انتظامیہ اس بات کی متلاشی ہے کہ ملکی توانائی کی ضروریات کو بہتر انداز میں پورا کیا جا سکے۔ پاکستان کے قطر کے ساتھ پہلے ہی طویل مدتی ایل این جی سپلائی کے دو معاہدے موجود ہیں، تاہم آبنائے ہرمز کی بندش کی وجہ سے ان معاہدوں کے تحت کارگوز کی آمد انتہائی محدود ہو چکی ہے۔

اس دورے کی بنیادی اہمیت یہ ہے کہ موسم سرما میں ملک میں گیس کی طلب میں اضافہ ہو جاتا ہے اور مہنگے کارگوز کی خریداری سے قومی خزانے پر باریش بوجھ پڑتا ہے۔ حکومتی کوشش ہے کہ باضابطہ مذاکرات کے ذریعے سستی ایل این جی کے حصول کو ممکن بنایا جائے تاکہ عام صارفین اور معیشت کو اس کا ریلیف مل سکے۔

متعلقہ حکام اس تمام معاملے پر گہری نظر رکھے ہوئے ہیں اور امید ظاہر کی جا رہی ہے کہ اس دورے کے مثبت نتائج سامنے آئیں گے۔ اس سے قبل بھی گیس کی ترسیل اور سپلائی کو برقرار رکھنے کے لیے مختلف سطح پر رابطے جاری رہے ہیں تاکہ توانائی کے بحران سے بچا جا سکے۔

stories.title: خلیجی ممالک نے کویت میں مشترکہ فوجی کمانڈ کا جدید مرکز قائم کرنے کا فیصلہ کر لیا
stories.summary:
خلیجی ممالک کے مابین باہمی عسکری تعاون کو مزید فروغ دینے کے لیے ایک اہم فیصلہ کیا گیا ہے جس کے تحت کویت میں مشترکہ فوجی کمانڈ کا ایک نیا اور جدید مرکز قائم کیا جائے گا۔ عرب میڈیا کی رپورٹس کے مطابق کویت سٹی میں اس کمانڈ سینٹر کے قیام کی باضابطہ منظوری دی جا چکی ہے۔

اس نئے فوجی مرکز کے قیام کا مقصد خلیجی خطے میں سکیورٹی اور دفاعی ڈھانچے کو زیادہ مربوط بنانا ہے۔ طے پانے والے فیصلوں کے مطابق اس مشترکہ کمانڈ کے لیے مناسب اور تربیت یافتہ فوجی دستے بھی مختص کیے جائیں گے تاکہ کسی بھی ہنگامی یا ضرورت کی صورت میں مشترکہ کارروائیوں کو بہتر انداز میں چلایا جا سکے۔

خطے کے امن اور استحکام کے تناظر میں اس اقدام کو انتہائی اہمیت کا حامل قرار دیا جا رہا ہے۔ خلیجی ممالک طویل عرصے سے دفاعی شعبے میں اشتراکِ عمل کو بڑھانے کے خواہاں رہے ہیں اور اس نئے کمانڈ سینٹر کا قیام اسی سلسلے کی ایک بڑی کڑی ہے۔

کویت میں بننے والا یہ مرکز خطے کے ممالک کے درمیان عسکری رابطوں، انٹیلی جنس شیئرنگ اور مشترکہ مشقوں کو مربوط کرنے میں بنیادی کردار ادا کرے گا۔ اس پیش رفت سے خلیجی خطے کی دفاعی پوزیشن مزید مستحکم ہوگی۔

stories.title: Dr Uzma Khan Files Third Plea for Early Contempt Hearing Over Imran's Treatment
stories.summary:
Dr Uzma Khan, sister of imprisoned PTI founder Imran Khan, approached the Supreme Court on Tuesday for the third time to request an early hearing of a contempt plea against the federal government. The legal action accuses authorities of defying an August 18 Supreme Court order directing that the former prime minister be transferred to Islamabad's Shifa International Hospital for medical care. Instead of complying, authorities initially took Imran to the Pakistan Institute of Medical Sciences before returning him to prison.

The Supreme Court's registrar office previously turned down two similar requests, citing a backlog of 94 pending criminal original petitions in the same category that must be heard turn-wise. The fresh application, filed through Advocate Uzair Karamat Bhandari under the Supreme Court Rules of 2025, emphasizes extreme urgency following recent reports that Imran's blood pressure spiked to 192. The plea argues that his fundamental rights to health, well-being, and family access—including weekly visits from sisters and phone calls with his sons—continue to be violated.

The contempt petition names several key respondents, including Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif, Islamabad Chief Commissioner Sohail Ashraf, Interior Secretary Ahmed Raza Sarwar, Punjab Inspector General Prisons Mian Salik Jalal, and Adiala Jail Superintendent Sajid Baig. The legal battle also intersects with jurisdictional tensions between the Supreme Court and the newly empowered Federal Constitutional Court, which previously issued directives to requisition related constitutional cases under Article 175-E.

This matter is critical as it highlights ongoing disputes regarding the medical rights and incarceration conditions of a high-profile political figure. The Supreme Court previously deferred its own proceedings on the health petitions to maintain judicial propriety, leaving the timeline for addressing the detained leader's treatment and family access unresolved.

stories.title: چاند نظر نہیں آیا، ملک بھر میں یکم جمادی الثانی 12 نومبر کو ہوگی
stories.summary:
چاند کی رویت کے حوالے سے مرکزی رویت ہلال کمیٹی کا اجلاس اسلام آباد میں منعقد ہوا جس کی صدارت چیئرمین مولانا عبدالخبیر آزاد نے کی۔ اس کے علاوہ ملک بھر میں زونل کمیٹیوں کے اجلاس بھی اپنے اپنے متعلقہ ہیڈ کوارٹرز میں منعقد کیے گئے تاکہ ماہِ نو کی رویت سے متعلق تمام شہادتیں اکٹھی کی جا سکیں۔

اجلاس کے بعد میڈیا کو بریفنگ دیتے ہوئے چیئرمین مولانا عبدالخبیر آزاد نے اعلان کیا کہ آج ملک کے بیشتر حصوں میں مطلع بالکل صاف رہا تاہم پاکستان کے کسی بھی مقام سے جمادی الثانی 1448 ہجری کا چاند دیکھنے کی کوئی بھی شہادت موصول نہیں ہوئی۔ 

چاند کی شہادتیں موصول نہ ہونے کی بنیاد پر کمیٹی نے باضابطہ فیصلہ کیا کہ موجودہ مہینے کا اختتام اس حساب سے ہوگا اور نئے اسلامی مہینے کی ابتدا کی جائے گی۔ اس طرح ملک بھر میں یکم جمادی الثانی 1448 ہجری 12 نومبر بروز بدھ کو ہوگی۔

رویت ہلال کمیٹی کا یہ اعلان اسلامی تقویم کے حساب سے انتہائی اہمیت کا حامل ہوتا ہے کیونکہ اس سے ملک بھر کے تمام سرکاری و نجی اداروں اور عوام کو نئے اسلامی مہینے کے آغاز کا باضابطہ علم ہوتا ہے اور تمام مذہبی و قمری تقریبات اسی حساب سے طے کی جاتی ہیں۔

stories.title: گوجرانوالہ سے آنے والی اسکول بس کو شوالہ کے قریب حادثہ، ڈرائیور جاں بحق اور 30 افراد زخمی
stories.summary:
گوجرانوالہ سے بچوں کو لے کر آنے والی ایک اسکول بس کو شوالہ کے مقام پر شدید ٹریفک حادثے کا سامنا کرنا پڑا ہے۔ مری سے تعلق رکھنے والے ریسکیو حکام کے مطابق اس خوفناک حادثے کے نتیجے میں بس کا ڈرائیور موقع پر ہی جاں بحق ہو گیا جبکہ بچوں سمیت کم از کم 30 افراد زخمی ہوئے ہیں۔

واقعے کی اطلاع ملتے ہی ریسکیو ٹیمیں فوری طور پر جائے وقوعہ پر پہنچیں اور تمام زخمیوں کو طبی امداد کی فراہمی کے لیے تحصیل ہیڈ کوارٹر (ٹی ایچ کیو) اسپتال مری منتقل کیا۔ اسپتال ذرائع کے مطابق حادثے میں زخمی ہونے والے افراد میں سے 3 کی حالت انتہائی تشویشناک بتائی جا رہی ہے جنہیں خصوصی طبی امداد دی جا رہی ہے۔

اس المناک حادثے سے علاقے میں غم و غصے اور افسوس کی لہر دوڑ گئی ہے، کیونکہ اس میں بڑی تعداد میں معصوم بچے سوار تھے۔ مری کے پہاڑی اور کچے راستوں یا موڑ پر پیش آنے والے ایسے حادثات مسافروں اور بالخصوص اسکول کے بچوں کی سلامتی کے لیے بڑے خطرات کی عکاسی کرتے ہیں۔

متعلقہ حکام اور انتظامیہ نے حادثے کی وجوہات جاننے کے لیے کارروائی شروع کر دی ہے تاکہ یہ معلوم ہو سکے کہ بس کو تکنیکی خرابی پیش آئی یا ڈرائیور کی غفلت کی وجہ سے یہ قیمتی جانیں خطرے میں پڑیں۔ زخمی بچوں کے لواحقین بھی اسپتال پہنچ چکے ہیں۔

stories.title: پنجاب حکومت نے وفاقی وزیر چوہدری سالک حسین سے سیکیورٹی واپس لے لی
stories.summary:
پنجاب حکومت نے وفاقی وزیر برائے اوورسیز پاکستانیز چوہدری سالک حسین اور دیگر وفاقی وزرا سے پنجاب پولیس کی ایلیٹ فورس کا مستقل پروٹوکول واپس لے لیا ہے۔ پولیس ذرائع کے مطابق ایلیٹ فورس کے اہلکاروں کو فوری طور پر واپس رپورٹ کرنے کے احکامات جاری کیے گئے ہیں، اور اب وفاقی وزرا کو پنجاب آمد پر صرف عارضی پروٹوکول فراہم کیا جائے گا۔ وفاقی وزیر چوہدری سالک حسین نے خود بھی سیکیورٹی واپس لیے جانے کی تصدیق کی ہے۔

مسلم لیگ کے ترجمان مصطفیٰ ملک نے اس فیصلے پر شدید ردعمل کا اظہار کرتے ہوئے کہا کہ اس سے صوبائی حکومت کی اصل ذہنیت ظاہر ہوتی ہے کیونکہ ان سے مثبت تنقید بھی برداشت نہیں ہو رہی۔ انہوں نے مؤقف اختیار کیا کہ چوہدری سالک حسین نے کرپشن کے خلاف حق کی بات کہی ہے جس پر عوام کی دعائیں ان کے ساتھ ہیں۔ ترجمان کا کہنا تھا کہ سیکیورٹی واپس لینے سے کوئی پریشانی نہیں ہے، اصل مسئلہ وہ کرپشن ہے جس کی نشاندہی چوہدری سالک نے کی ہے۔

یہ اقدام ایسے وقت میں سامنے آیا ہے جب سیاسی شخصیات کے درمیان بیانات کی جنگ جاری ہے اور حکومت اور اس کے اتحادیوں کے تعلقات کے حوالے سے مختلف قیاس آرائیاں کی جا رہی ہیں۔ پنجاب حکومت کی جانب سے وفاقی وزیر کی سیکیورٹی واپس لینے کے اس فیصلے کو سیاسی حلقوں میں اہم اور معنی خیز قرار دیا جا رہا ہے۔

اس پیشرفت سے صوبائی اور وفاقی سطح پر سیاسی کشیدگی میں اضافے کا اشارہ ملتا ہے۔ مسلم لیگ کے ترجمان کے بیانات سے یہ واضح ہوتا ہے کہ حکومت کی جانب سے اٹھائے جانے والے اس نوعیت کے اقدامات کے باوجود وہ اپنے مؤقف پر قائم ہیں اور کرپشن کے خلاف آواز بلند کرتے رہیں گے۔

stories.title: Unicef Warns Gaza Flood Risk Rises as Israel Blocks Repair Equipment
stories.summary:
The United Nations children's agency announced on Tuesday that Israel rejected the importation of vital equipment needed to repair a critical stormwater basin in Gaza. Unicef warned that the damaged facility, the Sheikh Radwan stormwater basin in Gaza City, faces an imminent risk of overflowing with contaminated sewage following heavy rainfall, directly threatening the health and safety of nearby displaced residents.

According to Unicef representative James Elder, the agency spent a year collaborating with Israeli authorities and US President Donald Trump’s Board of Peace on a $3 million rehabilitation plan. However, COGAT, the Israeli military agency overseeing humanitarian affairs, rejected the project on security grounds within the past few days. Local authorities report that extensive damage to water infrastructure and pumping vehicles during Israel's military campaign has left over two million displaced residents living mostly in vulnerable tent camps, compounding the danger of toxic sewage flooding makeshift homes and sparking disease outbreaks.

The warning comes as heavy winter rains have already flooded tens of thousands of tents across the Gaza Strip. Recent flooding incidents, including a tragic sand embankment collapse that killed four people—including three young children—have underscored the severe seasonal risks facing the population. World Health Organization spokesperson Christian Lindmeier corroborated these concerns, noting that nearly one million displaced individuals now face medium or high flood risks alongside acute sanitation and water service deficits.

This development highlights the ongoing humanitarian crisis in Gaza, where little progress has been made under last year's US-brokered ceasefire due to stalled negotiations over Hamas disarming and Israeli troop withdrawals. The blocked repairs matter because an overflow of the basin threatens to trigger entirely preventable health catastrophes and displace families once again.

stories.title: ایرانی کمانڈر کی نئی میزائل سٹی کے افتتاح پر دشمن کو سخت دھمکی
stories.summary:
ایرانی مسلح افواج کے چیف آف اسٹاف میجر جنرل علی عبداللہی نے پاسداران انقلاب کی ایرواسپیس فورس کی نئی میزائل سٹی کے افتتاح کے موقع پر دشمن کو خبردار کیا ہے کہ مستقبل میں کسی بھی جنگ کی صورت میں ایک کے بعد ایک حیران کن سرپرائزز سامنے آئیں گے۔ انہوں نے اس تقریب میں ایرو اسپیس فورس کے عہدیداروں اور فوج میں اپنے ساتھیوں کو ملک کے حقیقی ہیروز قرار دیا۔

جنرل علی عبداللہی نے دعویٰ کیا کہ ایران نے اپنے دشمنوں کے خلاف لڑتے ہوئے مثالی کامیابی حاصل کی ہے اور امریکا جیسی طاقت نے بھی ماضی میں کسی جنگ کے دوران اتنے کم عرصے میں اتنی بڑی تعداد میں جدید گولہ بارود اور فوجی سازوسامان کا استعمال نہیں کیا تھا۔ انہوں نے مزید کہا کہ فیصلہ کن پہلو اسلحہ یا وسائل نہیں بلکہ عوام کا اپنے ملک کے دفاع کا عزم ہے۔

ایرانی کمانڈر کے مطابق، امریکا اور اسرائیل نے اپنی تمام صلاحیتیں آزما لیں اور بھرپور انداز میں جنگ میں داخل ہوئے لیکن وہ اپنے مقاصد حاصل کرنے میں مکمل طور پر ناکام رہے اور انہیں میدان جنگ میں بڑے نقصانات کا سامنا کرنا پڑا۔ انہوں نے اس عزم کا اظہار کیا کہ مسلح افواج کسی بھی دشمن کے سامنے ڈٹ کر کھڑی رہیں گی اور مخالفین کے اندازے ایران کے فیصلوں پر اثرانداز نہیں ہو سکتے۔

نئی میزائل سٹی کے قیام کا مقصد پاسداران انقلاب کی ایرواسپیس فورس کے انفرا اسٹرکچر کو وسعت دینا، میزائل یونٹس کی آپریشنل صلاحیتوں کو تقویت دینا اور ممکنہ خطرات کے خلاف بھرپور تیاری برقرار رکھنا ہے۔ یہ افتتاح ایسے وقت میں سامنے آیا ہے جب خطے میں کشیدگی اور مختلف بحری و عسکری واقعات کی اطلاعات بھی موجود ہیں۔

stories.title: Rubio Affirms Continued US Economic Pressure on Iran During G7 Talks
stories.summary:
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio informed G7 foreign ministers that the United States will persist in placing severe economic sanctions on Iran. Speaking in Paris, Rubio defended the policy as a successful alternative to warfare or submitting to unreasonable demands from Tehran, stating it restricts the Iranian government from funding regional activities and proxies.

The meeting in Paris included top diplomats from Britain, Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, the United States, and the European Union. Four G7 diplomats noted that Rubio used forceful language regarding the Iranian leadership, with two sources reporting he called them "lunatics." The discussions came shortly after US President Donald Trump announced a temporary hold on new military strikes following appeals from regional leaders, though a naval blockade in the Strait of Hormuz remains in place.

Following talks in Washington, Qatari Prime Minister Sheikh Mohammed bin Abdulrahman Al-Thani made an unannounced visit to the Paris G7 gathering. The Qatari leader, serving as a key intermediary, conveyed cautious optimism that a diplomatic resolution might still be attainable instead of further military escalation. European ministers and Saudi representatives met with him during the stop.

Within the US administration, Rubio, White House Chief of Staff Stephen Miller, and Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent strongly support maintaining heavy economic pressure. Conversely, Vice President JD Vance has attributed recent Republican midterm election setbacks to the conflict and favors a negotiated deal. President Trump currently maintains that a viable agreement is not achievable, and the White House did not immediately comment on the matter.

stories.title: Fawad Chaudhry Criticizes Maryam Nawaz Over Jhelum Project Inaugurations
stories.summary:
Former federal minister Fawad Chaudhry has criticized Punjab Chief Minister Maryam Nawaz for inaugurating development projects in Jhelum that were originally initiated during the PTI administration. Reacting to her visit, Chaudhry stated it was positive the work was finally inaugurated but argued that political nameplates would not succeed in the region.

Chaudhry claimed that these local initiatives would have been finished four years earlier if not for political interference, alleging the current government damaged development quality. He noted that over Rs210 million was paid in land compensation while roads were narrowed to single lanes, and that a local trauma centre had remained almost ready for five years without final completion. Furthermore, he credited his administration with finishing the long-pending Jalalpur Canal project dating back to 1898.

The former minister asserted that Maryam Nawaz announced no new projects for Jhelum during her trip, relying instead on PTI's previous work. He maintained that Jhelum remains a political stronghold for his party, suggesting the PML-N would struggle to secure victories against them or even unknown candidates in the area. Meanwhile, in a separate event, Federal Minister Ahsan Iqbal addressed graduating engineers at UET Lahore, urging them to drive Pakistan's economic transformation by 2047.

stories.title: راولپنڈی ٹیسٹ: پاکستان کی مضبوط پوزیشن، نوجوان ثاقب خان کی شاندار بولنگ
stories.summary:
راولپنڈی ٹیسٹ میچ کے دوسرے دن کا کھیل ختم ہونے پر پاکستان نے سری لنکا کے خلاف اپنی پوزیشن مضبوط کر لی ہے۔ دن کے اختتام تک سری لنکا نے تین وکٹوں کے نقصان پر 114 رنز بنائے تھے اور وہ پاکستان کی پہلی اننگز کے 434 رنز کے مجموعی اسکور سے اب بھی 320 رنز پیچھے ہے۔

پاکستان کی جانب سے میچ میں ڈیبو کرنے والے نوجوان بولر ثاقب خان نے نپی تلی بولنگ کا مظاہرہ کرتے ہوئے سری لنکا کے تجربہ کار بلے باز دنیش چندی مل اور لاہیرو اوڈارا کو آؤٹ کر کے ٹیسٹ کرکٹ میں اپنی پہلی وکٹیں حاصل کیں۔ اس میچ میں ثاقب خان کے علاوہ طیب عارف، محمد طحہ اور عرفات منہاس نے بھی پاکستان کے لیے ڈیبو کیا۔

پہلے روز کپتان بابر اعظم، طیب عارف اور محمد طحہ نے شاندار نصف سنچریاں اسکور کی تھیں جبکہ دوسرے روز عرفات منہاس نے اہم موقع پر 72 گیندوں پر 52 رنز بنائے۔ سعود شکیل نے بھی 93 رنز کی ذمہ دارانہ اننگز کھیلی جس کے بعد پاکستان نے نو وکٹوں پر 434 رنز بنا کر اننگز ڈیکلیئر کر دی۔ سری لنکن کپتان کوشال مینڈس نے ٹاس جیت کر پہلے بولنگ کا فیصلہ کیا تھا تاکہ پچ پر موجود نمی کا فائدہ اٹھایا جا سکے، لیکن پاکستانی بلے بازوں نے اس حکمت عملی کو ناکام بنا دیا۔

ثاقب خان کی بولنگ پر کرکٹ حلقوں میں مختلف تبصرے سامنے آئے جہاں کچھ مبصرین نے ان کی کم رفتار پر بحث کی تو حامیوں نے سیم موومنٹ اور ڈومیسٹک کارکردگی کو سراہا۔ سری لنکا کی طرف سے اسیتھا فرنینڈو نے دو جبکہ دیگر بولرز نے ایک ایک وکٹ حاصل کی۔

stories.title: عثمان خواجہ کا انکشاف: لارڈز ٹیسٹ میں ایم سی سی ارکان کا نسل پرستانہ رویہ
stories.summary:
آسٹریلوی سابق ٹیسٹ کرکٹر عثمان خواجہ نے اپنی خود نوشت ’صبر‘ میں 2023 کی ایشز سیریز کے دوران لارڈز ٹیسٹ کے ہنگامہ خیز واقعے سے متعلق سنسنی خیز انکشافات کیے ہیں۔ انہوں نے لکھا کہ جونی بیئرسٹو کے متنازع رن آؤٹ کے بعد جب آسٹریلوی کھلاڑی لنچ کے وقفے میں پویلین واپس آ رہے تھے تو لارڈز کے لانگ روم میں موجود بعض ایم سی سی ارکان نے ان کے خلاف نازیبا زبان استعمال کی اور گالیاں دیں۔

کتاب میں بیان کردہ تفصیلات کے مطابق، لانگ روم میں موجود افراد نے آسٹریلوی کھلاڑیوں کو گالیاں دیتے ہوئے خصوصی مراعات یافتہ شرابیوں کے ہجوم کی طرح رویہ اپنایا اور بعض موقعوں پر خاموش رہنے کو کہا گیا۔ عثمان خواجہ نے اس ہجوم کی تشبیہ کتوں کے غول سے دی جو اپنے شکار پر جھپٹنے کے لیے تیار ہوں، تاہم ابتدا میں وہ اس صورتحال پر صدمے کے باعث صرف ہنس دیے۔ اسکائی اسپورٹس کی فوٹیج میں بھی خواجہ کو ایک رکن کے سامنے رک کر بات کرتے اور اسٹیورڈز کو آگاہ کرتے دیکھا گیا تھا۔

یاد رہے کہ اس واقعے کے فوری بعد میریلیبون کرکٹ کلب (ایم سی سی) نے نامناسب رویے پر فوری کارروائی کرتے ہوئے تین ارکان کو معطل کر دیا تھا۔ بعد ازاں تحقیقات کے نیتجے میں چار ماہ بعد ایک رکن کو کلب سے مستقل طور پر نکال دیا گیا جبکہ دو دیگر ارکان پر بالترتیب ساڑھے چار سال اور ڈھائی سال کی پابندی عائد کی گئی۔

یہ انکشافات ایسے وقت میں سامنے آئے ہیں جب کرکٹ کی دنیا میں کھلاڑیوں اور تماشائیوں کے مابین اخلاقیات اور رویوں کے حوالے سے بحث جاری رہتی ہے، اور اس واقعے نے ایک بار پھر لارڈز کے پویلین کے روایتی ماحول پر سوالات کھڑے کر دیے ہیں۔

stories.title: Take-Two CEO Hints at Faster Release Schedules for Rockstar Games Post-GTA 6
stories.summary:
As the launch of Grand Theft Auto 6 approaches after more than 13 years since GTA 5, Take-Two CEO Strauss Zelnick has suggested that future game releases from Rockstar Games could arrive more quickly. Speaking in an interview with IGN, Zelnick addressed whether the studio might accelerate its production timelines moving forward.

Zelnick indicated that the speed and nature of content from major franchises like Grand Theft Auto will change significantly over the upcoming decade. While not directly promising a faster arrival for a potential GTA 7, his remarks imply that workflow improvements and accumulated development experience could reduce waiting periods between major offerings.

Comments previously shared by Rockstar developers in October shed light on these potential changes. The creation of GTA 6 involved establishing foundational improvements, including a superior game engine, upgraded tools, and experienced teams that could streamline future development processes. However, industry observers note that faster releases might not strictly apply to massive standalone sequels like GTA 7 or Red Dead Redemption 3.

Instead, accelerated content delivery could encompass ongoing updates for existing titles or expanded features for GTA Online. Ultimately, the timeline for any follow-up to GTA 6 will rely heavily on Rockstar's internal development strategies and production requirements.

stories.title: Britain Asserts Military Base Security Following US Refuelling Plane Relocation
stories.summary:
British officials stated that military bases in the UK remain secure after the United States relocated large refuelling aircraft from an airbase in eastern England. Flight tracking data indicated that at least ten Boeing KC-135R Stratotanker planes departed from RAF Mildenhall on Monday, with destinations including Scotland, Germany, and Spain. Additionally, three Osprey multipurpose aircraft flew to nearby RAF Lakenheath.

The aircraft movements followed what the Wall Street Journal reported as a security threat originating from Iran, marking the second such evacuation in three months. The US European Command declined to comment on specific force protection measures, noting that aircraft relocations occur routinely for various operational reasons. A spokesperson for Prime Minister Andy Burnham affirmed that base protection is a top priority, supported by constant security reviews and ongoing investments in air defense and counter-drone capabilities.

While Iran has denied direct involvement in specific UK attacks, the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps previously designated foreign airbases used by American forces as legitimate targets. British authorities have warned of heightened Iranian recruitment and plotting over the past year, resulting in numerous arrests linked to operations targeting military sites. These security concerns follow an incident in September at RAF Fairford, where bombers were removed after suspicious activity near the perimeter fence.

In response to the current threats, the US reportedly elevated the security posture at RAF Mildenhall and RAF Lakenheath to FPCON Charlie, the second-highest defensive threat level. British intelligence chief Ken McCallum recently noted an increase in Iranian attempts to strike difficult targets like military installations, highlighting ongoing tensions between Western nations and Iran.

stories.title: US Defense Secretary Hegseth Dismisses Impeachment Push as Sabotage
stories.summary:
United States Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth strongly condemned recent efforts to impeach him, labeling the proceedings as a farce destined to fail. Speaking at a press conference in Washington on Tuesday, Hegseth defended his actions regarding the Iran war and argued that the legislative maneuverings against him were acts of sabotage rather than genuine patriotism. This marked his first appearance at a Pentagon news conference since May.

The public remarks came just a day after US Representative Thomas Massie, a Republican from Kentucky, officially introduced eight articles of impeachment targeting the defense chief over allegations of abuse of power during the military conflict with Iran. Comparing the current situation to past political actions, Hegseth noted that previous endeavors to impeach President Donald Trump had ultimately collapsed and predicted the same outcome for the current resolution.

Addressing the military operations in Iran directly, Hegseth expressed pride in executing the missions and stated that he would repeat the decisions without hesitation. He emphasized his full support for every operation carried out under his watch, standing firmly behind the military actions that prompted the congressional backlash.

Meanwhile, Representative Massie utilized social media platform X to outline the legislative steps ahead in the House of Representatives. According to Massie, lawmakers were scheduled to vote on an initial procedural motion designed to defeat the resolution, with successful avoidance of that procedural block clearing the path for an actual debate and subsequent vote on the articles of impeachment.

stories.title: Sri Lankan Share Market Rises Driven by Financial and Communications Stocks
stories.summary:
Equities in Sri Lanka finished the trading session higher on Tuesday, propelled upward primarily by gains within the financial and communications sectors. According to exchange data, the CSE All-Share index climbed by 2.75 percent to settle at 22,123.39 points at the close of the market.

Key drivers of the upward movement included the Commercial Bank of Ceylon and Dialog Axiata, which registered notable gains of 4.28 percent and 4.88 percent, respectively, providing the strongest positive influence on the overall index during the session.

Market activity also saw an expansion in overall participation. Trading volume on the index grew to 249.3 million shares, showing an increase compared to the 144.4 million shares recorded during the preceding session.

Financial metrics showed that the equity market turnover climbed to 7.91 billion Sri Lankan rupees, equivalent to approximately $23.81 million, up from 3.33 billion rupees in the previous session. In terms of investor participation, foreign investors acted as net sellers by offloading stocks valued at 1.26 billion rupees, whereas domestic investors operated as net buyers, acquiring shares worth 7.85 billion rupees.

stories.title: Gulf Markets Climb as Trump Rules Out Immediate Strikes on Iran
stories.summary:
Financial markets across the Gulf rose on Tuesday following comments from United States President Donald Trump stating that military action against Iran is unnecessary at the present moment. Trump chose to delay new strikes after receiving appeals from regional allies, including the prime minister of Qatar, though a naval blockade in the Strait of Hormuz remains active. In Saudi Arabia, the benchmark index climbed 0.6% to close at 10,168, with Al Rajhi Bank advancing 2.6% and Saudi National Bank increasing 0.8%, while oil giant Saudi Aramco fell 1.9%. The upward market movement was also supported by positive third-quarter corporate earnings, according to Milad Azar, a market analyst at XTB MENA.

The positive regional sentiment helped push other regional bourses higher. Dubai's main share index advanced 1.4% to reach 6,170, supported by a 3.5% increase in top lender Emirates NBD, while logistics firm Aramex surged 7.5% as the index's top gainer following a significant rise in third-quarter profit. Abu Dhabi's index grew 0.8% to 9,556, and Qatar's index added 0.7% to reach 10,177. Outside the Gulf, Egypt's blue-chip index jumped 2.1% to 52,503, bolstered by a 2.3% gain for Commercial International Bank after it reported higher third-quarter net interest income. Additional gains were recorded in Bahrain, where the index rose 0.2% to 1,824, Oman, which increased 0.6% to 7,279, and Kuwait, which inched up 0.1% to reach 8,975.

Despite the calmer stock market mood, military tensions surrounding Saudi territory escalated sharply overnight. Saudi-led coalition forces reported intercepting two missiles launched toward Riyadh by the Iran-aligned Houthis. Authorities also intercepted a ballistic missile targeting the kingdom's southern region and a drone flying over the Eastern Province. The Eastern Province serves as Saudi Arabia's primary economic hub, containing the majority of its oil and gas reserves as well as the headquarters of Aramco, a site that sustained heavy damage during an attack in October.

Traders are currently closely monitoring ongoing negotiations aimed at easing disruptions to commercial shipping within critical regional sea lanes. The confirmation that additional military strikes are currently off the table has provided steady momentum to regional trading. Investors continue to assess the broader geopolitical landscape alongside robust corporate financial results released for the third quarter across multiple regional economies.

stories.title: بگ باس 20 میں والد سلیم خان کو خراجِ تحسین پر سلمان خان آبدیدہ
stories.summary:
بالی ووڈ کے معروف سپر اسٹار سلمان خان دیوالی کے خصوصی موقع پر نشر ہونے والے ریئلٹی شو ’بگ باس 20‘ کے ’ویک اینڈ کا وار‘ ایپی سوڈ کے دوران اپنے جذبات پر قابو نہ رکھ سکے اور ان کی آنکھیں نم ہو گئیں۔ یہ جذباتی منظر اس وقت پیش آیا جب معروف گلوکار موہت چوہان نے شو میں بطور مہمان شرکت کرتے ہوئے سلمان خان کے والد اور نامور اسکرین رائٹر سلیم خان کو بھرپور خراجِ تحسین پیش کیا۔

موہت چوہان نے گفتگو کے دوران اس بات کا اعتراف کیا کہ وہ خود تو سلمان خان کے بڑے مداح ہیں ہی، لیکن ان کے والد سلیم خان کے مداح اس سے بھی کہیں زیادہ ہیں۔ اس خراجِ تحسین کے بعد موہت چوہان نے سلمان خان سے اجازت لے کر 1963 میں ریلیز ہونے والی فلم ’بچپن‘ کا ایک پرانا گیت ’مجھے تم سے محبت ہے، مگر میں کہہ نہیں سکتا‘ گایا۔ یہ وہ زمانہ تھا جب سلیم خان اسکرین رائٹر کے طور پر شہرت حاصل کرنے سے قبل فلموں میں اداکاری کے جوہر دکھا رہے تھے۔

والد کے ابتدائی فلمی کیریئر اور ماضی کی یاد تازہ ہونے پر سلمان خان شدید جذباتی ہو گئے اور اپنے آنسو چھپانے کے لیے کچھ دیر کے لیے دوسری طرف منہ موڑ لیا۔ کیمرے نے ان کی آنکھوں میں موجود نمی کو واضح طور پر ریکارڈ کیا، جس نے شو میں موجود حاضرین کے ساتھ ساتھ ٹی وی سکرین کے سامنے بیٹھے ناظرین کو بھی گہرا متاثر کیا۔

یہ جذباتی لمحہ شو کی خاص زینت بنا اور سوشل میڈیا پر بھی کافی زیرِ بحث رہا، جہاں مداحوں نے سلمان خان کی اپنے والد کے لیے عقیدت اور محبت کو سراہا۔

stories.title: Government Plans Smart Meters on DISCO Transformers to Fight Theft
stories.summary:
The Pakistani government intends to install smart meters on electrical transformers across all power distribution companies, known as DISCOs, to combat electricity theft and prevent overbilling. Federal Minister for Economic Affairs Ahad Cheema announced the initiative on Tuesday while chairing a meeting in Islamabad focused on DISCO development programs and financing arrangements managed through the Economic Affairs Division. Participants at the meeting discussed progress made in securing necessary funding to execute the smart metering project, which is designed to ensure consumer protection and enhance billing accuracy.

Minister Cheema emphasized that structural arrangements will be put in place to guarantee the continuation of the metering project even after the privatization of DISCOs, requiring private investors to carry the initiative forward. Ongoing negotiations with multilateral development partners regarding current programs will proceed until privatization is finalized. If a DISCO undergoes privatization while preparations or negotiations are still underway, the relevant development and financing programs will be transferred directly to the private investor under agreed handover terms.

Furthermore, the minister stressed that any new projects initiated by a private investor within a DISCO must undergo competitive bidding and secure formal approval from the National Electric Power Regulatory Authority where applicable. He noted that the privatization process should not impose additional financial costs or undue pressure on consumers. The government intends to facilitate the transition smoothly while safeguarding consumer interests and ensuring that incoming investors strictly fulfill all financial and contractual obligations.

The high-level meeting in Islamabad was attended by several key government figures. Attendees included Federal Minister for Power Division Sardar Awais Ahmad Khan Leghari, the prime minister’s adviser on privatization, and senior officials representing various relevant ministries who reviewed the ongoing development programs and structural reforms.

stories.title: Three Arrested in Rawalpindi for Crude Oil Theft via Underground Tunnel
stories.summary:
Police in Rawalpindi have arrested three individuals accused of stealing crude oil from a main supply line operated by Pakistan Oilfields Limited. According to law enforcement officials, the suspects rented a residential property situated near the pipeline in the Ranyal area and excavated an underground tunnel spanning 181 feet to siphon crude oil directly from the infrastructure. The detained suspects were identified at the scene as Muhammad Mumtaz, Shaukat, and Muhammad Akram. Officers recovered 1,431 liters of crude oil from an underground storage tank located at the rented premises.

The formal First Information Report was registered following a complaint filed by POL Senior Executive Admin Shahid Ahmed. The police document states that the suspects allegedly managed to steal a total of 1,100 barrels of crude oil from the high-pressure main supply line. The value of the stolen petroleum is estimated to exceed Rs23.2 million. Investigators noted that the perpetrators utilized a clamp to attach a diversion pipe directly to the industrial supply line to extract the resources.

The registered police case also names five additional individuals—identified as Shah Muhammad, Sajid, Akhtar, Hafizur Rehman, and Zahid—who allegedly acted as caretakers of the house and participated in the crude oil theft operation. Local police have initiated further investigations into the criminal network to determine the full scope of the unauthorized extraction activities and trace any additional accomplices involved in the scheme.

In a separate and unrelated local sports development, the Karachi Press Club Super Sixes Night Cricket Tournament concluded with Kpc Blues winning the championship title. The team defeated Photographers XI by five wickets in a lopsided final match. The victory was secured largely due to a dominant bowling performance by fast bowlers Zahid Ghaffar, Shameer Khan, Rao Afnan, and Irshad Sanjrani, whose disciplined bowling attack proved insurmountable for the opposing side.

stories.title: اسمارٹ میٹرز کی تنصیب سے بجلی چوری اور اووربلنگ رک جائے گی: احد چیمہ
stories.summary:
وفاقی وزیر اقتصادی امور احد چیمہ کی زیر صدارت بجلی کی تقسیم کار کمپنیوں سے متعلق ایک اہم اجلاس منعقد ہوا۔ اجلاس میں پاور ڈویژن کے وزیر اویس لغاری، نجکاری کے مشیر اور مختلف وزارتوں کے اعلیٰ حکام نے شرکت کی۔ اس بیٹھک کے دوران ڈسکوز کے ترقیاتی منصوبوں کا تفصیلی جائزہ لیا گیا اور تمام کمپنیوں کے ٹرانسفارمرز پر اسمارٹ میٹر لگانے کے لیے فنڈز کے بندوبست پر غور کیا گیا۔ اسمارٹ میٹرنگ کے نظام کی مالی معاونت کے معاملے میں مثبت پیشرفت سامنے آئی ہے۔

اجلاس سے خطاب کرتے ہوئے احد چیمہ نے واضح کیا کہ اسمارٹ میٹرز لگنے سے بجلی کی چوری اور زائد بلنگ کے مسائل پر قابو پانے میں خاطر خواہ مدد ملے گی۔ انہوں نے مزید بتایا کہ ڈسکوز کی نجکاری کے بعد بھی اسمارٹ میٹرنگ کا یہ عمل جاری رکھنے کے لیے تمام ضروری انتظامات کیے جا رہے ہیں۔ حکومت ایسا لائحہ عمل تیار کرے گی جس کے ذریعے نجی سرمایہ کار اس منصوبے کو آگے لے کر جا سکیں گے۔

وفاقی وزیر کا کہنا تھا کہ اس منصوبے کے اندر صارفین، سرمایہ کاروں اور حکومت تینوں کے حقوق کا مکمل تحفظ یقینی بنایا جائے گا۔ ترقیاتی پروگراموں کے لیے کثیرالجہتی شراکت داروں کے ساتھ بات چیت نجکاری کا عمل مکمل ہونے تک جاری رہے گی۔ کسی بھی ڈسکو کی نجکاری کے وقت طے شدہ معاہدے کے تحت ترقیاتی پروگرام نجی سرمایہ کار کو منتقل کر دیے جائیں گے۔

احد چیمہ نے اس بات پر بھی زور دیا کہ نجکاری کے بعد بھی تمام ڈسکوز کو نیپرا کے قوانین کے مطابق ہی کام کرنا ہوگا۔ انہوں نے یقین دہانی کرائی کہ نجکاری کا مقصد کسی بھی قسم کے اضافی اخراجات یا بوجھ کو عام صارفین پر منتقل کرنا نہیں ہے اور حکومت اس پورے عمل میں عوام کے مفادات کا بھرپور تحفظ کرے گی۔

stories.title: Tesla to Discontinue Cybertruck as Large Electric Pickup Demand Wanes
stories.summary:
Tesla plans to discontinue its Cybertruck next year, marking a high-profile setback in the once-hyped category of massive electric pickup trucks. In a social media post on Saturday, Tesla CEO Elon Musk announced that production of the Cybertruck at the Austin, Texas, factory will be ramped up to clear an existing order backlog before the assembly line is dismantled around June or July. The wind-down will enable the company to shift manufacturing capacity toward producing Cybercab robotaxis, which have not yet been sold commercially. Sales of the angular, stainless-steel truck dropped 28% through September to roughly 11,600 vehicles, according to estimates from Motor Intelligence, falling far short of Musk's earlier annual prediction of 250,000 trucks. Federal regulatory filings also showed that Musk's space company, SpaceX, purchased Cybertrucks worth $131 million from Tesla at list price last year.

The broader market for large electric pickups has proved difficult for competitors as well. Rival automakers General Motors and Ford Motor have seen deliveries of their full-size electric trucks lag behind expectations despite high initial hopes. Detroit automakers pivoted to electric pickups early in the decade to protect their market share and leverage the popularity of their profitable internal-combustion trucks. However, according to iSeeCars.com executive analyst Karl Brauer, automakers struggled to replicate their traditional success because large electric trucks are expensive to build due to costly batteries, with models like the Chevrolet Silverado EV starting around $62,000. Additionally, these vehicles often fail to match the practical utility of gas-powered trucks, such as hauling heavy equipment or towing horse trailers, leaving consumers paying more money for a less functional vehicle.

Recognizing the challenging economic realities of the segment, Ford CEO Jim Farley addressed the issue during an earnings call last year when explaining plans to phase out the Ford Lightning, an electric version of the F-150. Farley noted that larger vehicles require larger batteries, placing pressure on profit margins because customers are unwilling to pay a premium price. Ford has since shifted its focus toward developing a smaller electric pickup called the Fathom, scheduled for release late next year with an expected starting price of approximately $28,000. Meanwhile, other manufacturers are exploring hybrid solutions, with Stellantis planning to introduce an extended-range electric pickup next year that utilizes a gas-powered generator to recharge the battery while driving.

stories.title: Federal Government Reduces Petrol and Diesel Prices Effective November 11
stories.summary:
The federal government announced a price reduction for petroleum products, lowering petrol by Rs8 per litre and high-speed diesel by Rs7 per litre. According to a notification issued by the Petroleum Division, the new rates take effect on November 11, setting petrol at Rs338 per litre and high-speed diesel at Rs371 per litre for Wednesday. This adjustment follows an earlier price cut where petrol was reduced by Rs6.59 per litre and high-speed diesel by Rs4.25 per litre for the period between November 7 and November 10.

The recent fuel price adjustments occur amid ongoing volatility in global oil markets driven by renewed tensions between the United States and Iran, as well as the US-Israeli conflict with Iran. To help absorb market pressures, the government previously announced that oil refineries would absorb a burden of Rs15 billion per month to keep petrol prices Rs15 lower than global market rates. Additionally, a daily pricing mechanism was introduced on July 17 to replace weekly revisions in response to supply concerns.

Lower-income consumers have also been targeted through specific relief initiatives. On September 13, Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif launched a special scheme granting a Rs100 per litre discount on petrol for motorcycles, three-wheeler rickshaws, and cars with engines up to 800cc. The program is designed to benefit an estimated 11.8 million users by subsidizing a specific number of litres per month for two-wheelers, three-wheelers, and small cars.

Alongside price adjustments and consumer relief, the government reintroduced various austerity and fuel conservation measures in September. These guidelines mandate early closing times for commercial establishments, requiring markets, shopping malls, and general stores to shut by 9pm, marriage halls by 10pm, and restaurants and cafes by 11pm, while takeaway and home delivery services remain exempt from these restrictions.

stories.title: Trump Nominates Career Diplomat Natalie Baker as Ambassador to Pakistan
stories.summary:
United States President Donald Trump has officially nominated Natalie A. Baker to serve as the next US ambassador to Pakistan. The White House announced the nomination of Baker, a career member of the Senior Foreign Service from Texas who holds the rank of Minister-Counsellor, directing the appointment to the US Senate for formal confirmation.

Baker currently works as the permanent Chargé d’Affaires to Pakistan. She initially took on the role of Chargé d’Affaires ad interim at the embassy in January 2025 before receiving the permanent assignment the previous month. Her diplomatic posting arrives during a period of ongoing bilateral engagement between Washington and Islamabad concerning trade, investment, security, and regional issues. The last US ambassador to the post was Donald Blome, who concluded his tenure in January 2025.

Before her time in Islamabad, Baker functioned as the Deputy Chief of Mission at the US embassy located in Doha, Qatar, from August 2021 until July 2024. Her extensive career also features roles as Director of the Office of North African Affairs within the State Department's Near Eastern Affairs Bureau, Deputy Chief of Mission and Chargé d’Affaires at the US Mission to Libya, Deputy Director of the Iran Regional Presence Office at the US Consulate in Dubai, and Economic Counsellor at the US embassy in Kuwait. During the 2011 Libyan Revolution, she served as Political and Economic Counsellor in Libya until embassy personnel were forced to evacuate.

Baker's academic background includes a bachelor's degree earned from Princeton University and a master's degree in public policy from the Kennedy School of Government at Harvard University. In 2017, she graduated as a Distinguished Graduate from the National War College at the National Defence University. Additionally, she possesses language proficiencies in Arabic, Spanish, Farsi, and Russian, which support her extensive international diplomatic assignments.

stories.title: Incarcerated PTI Leader Shah Mahmood Qureshi Hospitalized Following Fall
stories.summary:
Senior Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf leader Shah Mahmood Qureshi, currently imprisoned at Kot Lakhpat jail, was transferred to the Punjab Institute of Cardiology in Lahore. His legal counsel, Rana Mudassar Umar, stated that the former foreign minister was hospitalized days after fainting and suffering a fall. Qureshi has been held behind bars since August 2023 and faces multiple indictments related to the May 9 riots, including a case regarding an attack on the Shadman police station.

According to his counsel, an application for his medical care was delayed due to holidays, and Qureshi was placed under observation for 24 hours to determine if formal admission was necessary. Last week, his daughter Meher Bano shared on social media that she learned of the fall during a family prison visit. His son, Zain Qureshi, also visited him in jail and reported that his father collapsed while walking in his barracks, urging authorities to provide a CT scan and dental care for a cracked tooth.

The PTI core committee recently expressed strong concern over the incident and demanded that the government, prison administration, and relevant courts immediately transfer Qureshi to a hospital for a comprehensive medical examination. This follows previous medical interventions, including a gallbladder removal procedure in December and a previous visit to the cardiology institute in May due to heart pain.

The matter highlights ongoing political tensions and concerns regarding the welfare of detained opposition figures in Pakistan. Qureshi remains in detention despite various acquittals, citing what his family describes as politically motivated delays by the government.

stories.title: US President Trump Nominates Natalie Baker as Ambassador to Pakistan
stories.summary:
US President Donald Trump has nominated career diplomat Natalie Baker to serve as Washington's next permanent ambassador to Pakistan. The appointment aims to fill a nearly two-year vacancy in the high-profile diplomatic post left by former ambassador Donald Blome. Baker has already been operating within Pakistan since August 2024, initially serving as Deputy Chief of Mission and later taking over as Chargé d’Affaires in January 2025.

Baker brings extensive international experience to the role, having previously worked in challenging geopolitical environments. Notably, she served as Political and Economic Counsellor in Libya from 2009 to 2011, remaining until the US Embassy was evacuated during the Libyan Revolution. Her background also includes helping coordinate the US military withdrawal from Iraq while stationed in Kuwait, alongside postings in Dubai, Turkmenistan, and Qatar.

Academically, Baker holds degrees from Princeton University and Harvard University, and is a distinguished graduate of the US National War College. Outside of her professional duties, she has adapted to local culture during her time in Islamabad, expressing appreciation for Pakistani cuisine such as palak paneer and dal, traditional multi-day wedding celebrations, and local cricket matches.

The nomination marks a crucial step in bilateral relations, addressing trade, security, and regional cooperation. However, Baker's appointment is not yet finalized, as she must undergo formal consideration and confirmation by the United States Senate before assuming the ambassadorship permanently.

stories.title: Brazil Forward Endrick Weighs January Exit from Real Madrid
stories.summary:
Brazilian international football forward Endrick stated on Tuesday that he is open to leaving Real Madrid when the transfer window reopens in January in search of regular playing time. Speaking from Singapore ahead of a friendly match against Japan, the 20-year-old emphasized that his primary goal is to play consistently, enjoy his football, and contribute goals and assists, much like he did during a successful loan spell at Lyon last season.

During the second half of the previous campaign, Endrick scored eight goals and provided eight assists across 21 appearances in French Ligue 1. That productive stint helped him secure a place in coach Carlo Ancelotti's World Cup squad. However, upon returning to Real Madrid, he has struggled for minutes under tough competition, particularly with Kylian Mbappe occupying his preferred position in the team.

Hampered by an injury at the start of the current campaign, Endrick has logged only 141 minutes of playing time across seven appearances in all competitions, scoring a single goal. While acknowledging that playing for Real Madrid is a major opportunity, he remains uncertain about his immediate future and is focused on finding the best career path.

The young forward is currently preparing to represent the Selecao in an upcoming friendly fixture in Singapore. His remarks highlight his desire for consistent developmental minutes as he evaluates his career options ahead of the upcoming winter transfer window.

stories.title: Pakistan-Sri Lanka Second Test Relocated to Rawalpindi Due to Lahore Smog
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Cricket Board announced that the second Test match between Pakistan and Sri Lanka has been shifted from Lahore to Rawalpindi. Originally planned to take place at Lahore's Gaddafi Stadium from November 17 to 21, the fixture will now be hosted at the Rawalpindi Cricket Stadium over the same scheduled dates. A board spokesperson confirmed that the relocation decision was finalized due to escalating smog levels and unfavorable weather conditions in the provincial capital.

The venue change is a direct response to Lahore's deteriorating environmental situation, as the city regularly battles severe winter air pollution. Stagnant atmospheric conditions, cooler temperatures, and emissions from both industrial activity and vehicles typically combine to trap heavy smog during the winter months. Poor air quality presents significant health and safety hazards for players, match officials, support personnel, and spectators during prolonged outdoor sporting events.

While the upcoming second Test has been moved to Rawalpindi, the first Test of the series between Pakistan and Sri Lanka is already underway at the Pindi Cricket Stadium. The Pakistan Cricket Board continues to monitor regional weather patterns to ensure player welfare and the smooth execution of international cricket fixtures in the country.

stories.title: Unbeaten Pakistan Defeats Nepal by 101 Runs in Under-19 Asia Cup
stories.summary:
Pakistan concluded their Group A campaign in the ACC Men’s Under-19 Asia Cup with a dominant 101-run victory over Nepal in Oman on Tuesday. Having already secured their qualification for the semi-finals prior to the match at the Al Amerat Cricket Ground, Pakistan successfully defended a competitive total to finish the group stage completely undefeated.

Opting to bat first, Pakistan experienced a shaky start, losing early wickets as Usman Khan, Jahangir Bilal, and Abdul Qadir fell cheaply to Nepalese bowlers Bipin Sharma and Sachin Bhatt. However, captain Farhan Yousaf and Ahmed Hussain rescued the innings with a crucial 135-run partnership. Farhan scored 74 runs from 95 balls, while Ahmed contributed a stellar 89 runs off 73 deliveries. Additional late runs from Hasnain Abbas Dar pushed Pakistan's final score to 275-7, with Bipin finishing as Nepal's pick of the bowlers with three wickets.

In response, Nepal failed to establish meaningful partnerships and was ultimately bowled out for 174 runs in 43.4 overs. Rohit Chand top-scored for Nepal with 37 runs, supported by Niraj Kumar Yadav and Abhay Yadav, but the run chase fell well short. Ahmed Hussain capped off his impressive all-around performance by taking four wickets for 35 runs, while Mohammad Sayyam and Mohammad Huzaifa claimed two wickets each.

With the group stage successfully concluded, Pakistan turns its focus toward the upcoming semi-finals as the squad continues its campaign to retain the continental Under-19 championship title.

stories.title: Uzma Khan Seeks Early Supreme Court Hearing for Imran Khan's Medical Transfer
stories.summary:
An application was submitted to the Supreme Court on Tuesday by Dr. Uzma Khan, sister of former prime minister Imran Khan, requesting an urgent hearing regarding his transfer from Adiala Jail to Shifa International Hospital. The legal filing seeks to enforce a previous August 18 order and asks the apex court to appoint a local commission or officer to oversee the medical transfer. 

Uzma, who is herself detained at Kot Lakhpat Jail under the Maintenance of Public Order, noted that recent media reports indicate Imran's blood pressure spiked to 192. The application argues that without an immediate hearing, his fundamental rights to health, medical advice, and family access will continue to be violated. This follows earlier requests by Senator Mashal Yousafzai and a separate contempt petition filed by Uzma over the alleged non-implementation of the August 18 directive.

The case has faced delays amid a jurisdictional dispute between the Supreme Court and the Federal Constitutional Court (FCC). While the FCC summoned records related to Imran's health on September 14, a three-member SC bench questioned the order days later, with Attorney General Mansoor Awan requesting three weeks to assist. With two months passing without the matter appearing on court cause lists, a lawyer emphasized that this jurisdictional ambiguity must be resolved.

The matter matters significantly because it directly impacts the former prime minister's health, safety, and fundamental legal rights amidst heightened public concern. Addressing the issue requires resolving complex institutional friction between Pakistan's top judicial bodies to prevent further delays in medical care.

stories.title: Pakistan Stock Exchange Surges Past 179,000 Points with Strong Momentum
stories.summary:
The Pakistan Stock Exchange recorded significant gains on Tuesday, November 10, 2026, as the benchmark KSE-100 Index jumped by 5,448.56 points, representing a 3.13 per cent increase. The index wrapped up the trading session at 179,335.24 points, improving upon its previous close of 173,886.69 points. Throughout the day, the market demonstrated steady upward movement, hitting an intraday high of 179,424.04 points alongside a low of 176,273.72 points according to official figures from the exchange.

Market participation across the Ready Market showed positive activity, with 363 companies registering gains, 107 experiencing declines, and 31 remaining unchanged out of a total of 501 tracked companies. Trading volume reached 972,432,676 shares, shifting from 1,479,999,348 shares in the preceding session. Meanwhile, the total traded value climbed to Rs. 50,665,195,283, compared to the earlier figure of Rs. 22,572,045,929. The overall market capitalization also expanded, rising to Rs. 19,397,292,871,364 from the prior session's Rs. 18,909,150,315,646.

In related sports updates from the region, KPC Blues secured the championship title of the Karachi Press Club Super Sixes Night Cricket Tournament. They claimed victory by defeating Photographers XI by five wickets in a one-sided final match. The bowling lineup for KPC Blues stifled their opponents, featuring disciplined performances from fast bowlers Zahid Ghaffar, Shameer Khan, Rao Afnan, and Irshad Sanjrani.

The strong financial performance of the stock market highlights robust investor activity and rising capitalization figures during the session. Market analysts and stakeholders closely monitor these metrics as indicators of economic health. The blend of robust financial trading and local sporting events marked a notable day of activity across business and community circles in Pakistan.

stories.title: PTI Leader Raises Concerns Over Imran Khan's Fluctuating Blood Pressure
stories.summary:
Barrister Salman Akram Raja voiced serious concerns regarding the health of Pakistan Tehreek-e-Insaf (PTI) founder Imran Khan, pointing out that his blood pressure has been unstable. Addressing journalists at the Dahgal checkpoint in Rawalpindi, the PTI leader stated that meetings with Noreen Bibi, Uzma Bibi, and other individuals had been restricted since August 25. He noted that regular access for lawyers, associates, and family members had also been halted.

Commenting on reports surrounding Imran Khan’s medical condition, Salman Akram Raja explained that the latest updates came via information brought forward by Salman Safdar. He stressed that unstable blood pressure, shifting between high and low readings, is alarming. The PTI leader cautioned that any adverse impact on the incarcerated founder's well-being would be unacceptable to both the party and the wider nation. When questioned about JUI-F chief Maulana Fazal ur Rehman, he stated that his party is open to collaborating with anyone committed to the Constitution and the law.

Previously on November 2, defence lawyer Salman Safdar visited Imran Khan and his wife, Bushra Bibi, at Adiala Jail to review their health and legal standing. The 40-minute meeting commenced at 4:30 pm, marking the first time Salman Safdar had met Imran Khan in seven months despite repeated pleas, while his meeting with Bushra Bibi occurred after an 11-month gap. Salman Safdar noted that the limited duration was insufficient to properly address the multitude of legal cases facing the PTI founder.

During that jail visit, both Imran Khan and Bushra Bibi personally informed their legal counsel about their living conditions and health statuses inside the facility. The ongoing restrictions on meetings and the reported health fluctuations continue to draw intense scrutiny from party leaders and supporters. The situation remains a central point of contention between PTI representatives and authorities regarding prison conditions and legal access.

stories.title: US-Brokered Peace Talks Open in Abu Dhabi Between Russia and Ukraine
stories.summary:
Russian and Ukrainian officials convened in Abu Dhabi on Tuesday for their first US-brokered peace negotiations since February. The meeting follows remarks made last week by President Donald Trump suggesting that a comprehensive agreement to end the conflict and secure European security was achievable. US envoy Jared Kushner informed delegates that prior discussions with both sides successfully narrowed gaps and that Washington holds positive ideas to reconcile remaining differences, emphasizing Trump's dedication to securing peace.

More than four and a half years after Russia initiated its full-scale invasion, and with Russian forces occupying roughly one-fifth of Ukraine, significant distance remains between Moscow and Kyiv regarding settlement terms. Rustem Umerov, leading the Ukrainian delegation, stated that Kyiv prioritizes obtaining lasting peace and security guarantees. Conversely, Russian Foreign Minister Sergei Lavrov emphasized Moscow's stance that a broad European security framework must be negotiated before addressing specific conflict details. Lavrov also dismissed the concept of a truce, claiming European nations sought to buy time for Ukraine.

European officials have pushed for direct involvement in the diplomatic process to influence the resolution of the continent's deadliest conflict since World War Two. Prior to the main session, Ukrainian delegates held separate consultations with European, NATO, and EU representatives alongside US envoys Jared Kushner and Steve Witkoff. While France asserted that lasting peace requires addressing European security with European participation, Russia maintained that European presence at the talks was unnecessary.

Negotiations have regained momentum recently following a period where Washington focused heavily on the conflict in Iran. President Trump expressed optimism following a White House meeting with a special envoy of Russian President Vladimir Putin, though past predictions of an imminent deal have not materialized. Publicly, Putin maintains his demand that Ukraine surrender the entire eastern Donbas region before any peace agreement is finalized. Meanwhile, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy has rejected territorial concessions, arguing that recent battlefield performance and high Russian casualties have strengthened Ukraine's negotiating leverage.

stories.title: Senate Panel Alleges Federal Government Misspent Rs5 Trillion on Provincial Subjects
stories.summary:
Senator Barrister Zamir Hussain Ghumro claimed on Tuesday that the federal government expended over Rs5 trillion—equivalent to more than $18 billion—on devolved provincial subjects and ministries tied to Council of Common Interests matters, violating the Constitution. Citing findings from the Auditor General of Pakistan's report during a Senate Functional Committee on Devolution sub-committee meeting in Islamabad, the panel head noted that federal expenditures currently hover around Rs19 trillion against Rs20 trillion in total revenues, forcing heavy borrowing that totals $135 billion.

The PPP senator argued that strict adherence to the 18th Amendment and the proper transfer of Council of Common Interests matters under Article 154 would have eliminated the need for financial bailouts from the International Monetary Fund. He stated that over the past 15 years, the IMF provided Pakistan with $15 billion, whereas the government allocated $18 billion to $20 billion toward devolved ministries and institutions. Ghumro stressed that utilizing these funds for social development and infrastructure could have transformed the country, labelling the unauthorized spending a misuse of taxpayer funds.

According to the panel convener, the Federal Consolidated Fund is split between charged expenditures, such as remuneration for high constitutional officeholders and debt servicing, and other discretionary ministry grants. He asserted that the federal government possesses no constitutional obligation or authority to deliver provincial services like health, education, housing, or water, rendering expenses outside the Federal Legislative List illegal. He noted that summaries to dismantle 24 redundant ministries and institutions have been sent to the prime minister by the Cabinet Division and the Council of Common Interests, though a response remains pending.

The sub-committee also addressed representation and job shortages for provinces in federal appointments pursuant to Article 38(g) of the Constitution. Discussions revealed shortages exceeding 30,000 jobs in Balochistan and over 80,000 jobs in Sindh across various government grades. The Federal Public Service Commission secretary reported that special examinations and recruitment drives are underway to clear the backlog. Additionally, the panel expressed dissatisfaction with the Ministry of Information for failing to submit a timely devolution report regarding print media and broadcasting rights, granting the ministry 15 days to finalize compliance issues.

stories.title: Wapda Confirms Tarbela Dam Remains Safe Following Rock Collapse Incident
stories.summary:
The Water and Power Development Authority issued a press release on Tuesday confirming that the integrity of the main Tarbela Dam and its critical structures faces no threat following a rock collapse. The incident occurred at the 5th Extension Project construction site, triggering a surge of water into nearby work areas and prompting an immediate emergency response.

Following the collapse, construction activities were suspended and workers were directed toward safer locations. Authorities confirmed that no loss of life occurred. In response to the event, Wapda Chairman retired Lieutenant Muhammad Saeed visited the site on Monday and Thursday to inspect the intake structure, tunnel, power house, and other key project areas while receiving briefings from contractors, consultants, and project management.

The chairman subsequently presided over a site meeting to discuss potential causes and formulate short, medium, and long-term preventive measures alongside immediate response strategies. Wapda teams, consultants, and contractors reached a unanimous assessment that the main dam and its vital infrastructure remain completely secure, according to the official statement.

To address the incident thoroughly, the chairman ordered a departmental inquiry and instructed consultants to deliver a comprehensive report swiftly while finalising contingency plans to limit project delays. Swabi Deputy Commissioner Nasarullah Khan assured the public that the situation is fully under control, noting that river flows were managed through coordinated safety measures by technical teams and urging citizens to rely exclusively on official updates.

stories.title: Oxford Study Reveals 13 Pakistani Deaths in Greek Detention Since 2000
stories.summary:
Research published on Tuesday by the University of Oxford on the Detention Landscapes platform revealed that 13 Pakistani nationals have died in Greek police and immigration detention facilities since 2000. The archive aims to document border and immigration control deaths in the absence of reliable public data from Greek authorities.

The study found that at least 112 foreign nationals have died in Greek custody overall since 2000, with Pakistanis and Albanians representing the largest identified national groups at 13 deaths each, while the nationality of 32 individuals remains unspecified. Utilizing Freedom of Information requests, international reports, media archives, and interviews, researchers noted that at least 27 of these deaths occurred in pre-removal detention centers established after 2012.

Demographically, the documented victims were predominantly male, numbering 82 males compared to four females, with a median age of 33.5 years among the 70 individuals whose ages were recorded. Official sources attributed 44 deaths to suicide and 20 to pathological conditions, though 36 cases lacked a reported cause and non-governmental sources raised concerns regarding potential medical neglect and physical abuse.

The findings draw attention to broader systemic issues, highlighting a lack of transparent reporting by Greek authorities, minimal media follow-up on individual circumstances, and underlying connections between restrictive immigration policies, repressive policing, and violence against racialized people.

stories.title: جمہوریہ کانگو میں بزدلی کے الزام میں فوجیوں کو سزائے موت
stories.summary:
جمہوریہ کانگو میں ایک فوجی عدالت نے کم از کم 66 فوجیوں کو بزدلی، بغاوت اور احکامات سے سرکشی کے الزامات کے تحت سزائے موت سنا دی ہے۔ یہ سزائیں صوبہ شمالی کیوو کے علاقے والیکالے میں 71 فوجیوں کے مقدمے کی سماعت کے بعد سنائی گئیں، جن میں سے چار فوجیوں کو بری کر دیا گیا جبکہ ایک کو دس سال قید کی سزا دی گئی۔

فوجی حکام کے مطابق اس سخت قانونی کارروائی کا مقصد ملک کے مشرقی حصوں میں سرگرم مسلح گروہوں کے خلاف جاری آپریشنز کے دوران فوج کے اندر نظم و ضبط کو بہتر بنانا ہے۔ ان فوجیوں کو 20 اکتوبر کو گرفتار کیا گیا تھا اور ان پر الزام تھا کہ وہ فرنٹ فار دی ری فاؤنڈیشن آف دی نیشن کے جنگجوؤں کے ساتھ جھڑپوں کے دوران اپنی پوزیشنیں چھوڑ کر فرار ہو گئے تھے۔

جمہوریہ کانگو کی فوج طویل عرصے سے نظم و ضبط کی کمی، بدانتظامی اور اندرونی مسائل کا شکار رہی ہے جبکہ اہلکاروں کی طرف سے کم تنخواہوں اور ناکافی سازوسامان کی شکایات بھی کی جاتی رہی ہیں۔ حکومت نے مارچ 2024 میں سزائے موت پر عائد بیس سالہ پابندی ختم کر دی تھی تاکہ غداروں اور مسلح گروہوں میں شامل افراد سے سختی سے نمٹا جا سکے، حالانکہ اس فیصلے پر انسانی حقوق کی تنظیموں کی جانب سے کڑی تنقید بھی کی گئی تھی۔

ملک میں اس طرح کے عدالتی فیصلے پہلے بھی سامنے آ چکے ہیں، جن میں پچھلے ماہ بھی بزدلی کے الزام میں 27 فوجیوں کو سزائے موت سنائی گئی تھی۔ فرانسیسی نشریاتی ادارے کے اعداد و شمار کے مطابق سنہ 2025 کے آغاز سے اب تک سیکڑوں فوجیوں کو مختلف سزائیں سنائی جا چکی ہیں، جو ملک کی سکیورٹی فورسز میں پائی جانے والی سنگین انتظامی چیلنجز کی عکاس ہیں۔

stories.title: Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif Travels to Turkiye for COP31 Climate Summit
stories.summary:
Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif departed for Turkiye to take part in the Leaders' Summit of the 31st Conference of the Parties to the United Nations Framework Convention on Climate Change. The Foreign Office announced that the prime minister's scheduled visit runs from November 10 to November 12, with his address to the Leaders' Summit set for November 11.

During the high-level gathering, Prime Minister Shehbaz is expected to urge the global community to implement practical actions against climate change. The Foreign Office stated that he will spotlight Pakistan's domestic initiatives involving rapid solarisation and the expansion of renewable energy capacity as part of the country's transition to a resilient economy. Furthermore, he will outline national efforts to bolster disaster preparedness and early-warning systems while advocating for predictable, adequate, and accessible climate financing for developing nations.

On the sidelines of the summit, the prime minister will participate in a high-level roundtable hosted by the COP31 presidency. He also plans to conduct bilateral meetings with Turkish leadership and various other world leaders in attendance. The Foreign Office noted that his presence underscores Pakistan's dedication to the international climate agenda and reinforces cooperation to resolve ongoing environmental crises.

The COP31 conference commenced in the Turkish Mediterranean city of Antalya with discussions on climate funding. UN chief Antonio Guterres called on world leaders to address climate challenges seriously following a year marked by extreme weather, including punishing European heatwaves, Indonesian wildfires, and severe floods in Nepal. Observers suggest major breakthroughs may be limited due to prevailing geopolitical tensions and global economic strains.

stories.title: Sri Lanka Fights Back Against Pakistan on Day Two in Rawalpindi
stories.summary:
Dhananjaya de Silva and Kamindu Mendis led a crucial recovery for Sri Lanka, guiding the visiting team to 114-3 by stumps on the second day of the first Test against Pakistan in Rawalpindi on Tuesday. Mendis finished the day unbeaten on 40 and De Silva was not out on 22, having put together an unbroken partnership of 49 runs. Bad light eventually brought an early conclusion to the day's play while the pair were resisting the bowling attack.

Sri Lanka had earlier resumed the final session at 42-2 before opener Lahiru Udara maintained an aggressive approach, contributing 42 runs from 52 balls. Udara fell to debutant Saqib Khan, leaving the visitors at 65-3 following dismissals earlier in the afternoon by Mohammad Abbas and Saqib. The visiting side still trails Pakistan by 320 runs after the hosts declared their first innings at a commanding 434-9.

Pakistan continued building their total from an overnight score of 281-5, bolstered by a 96-run partnership for the sixth wicket between Saud Shakeel and wicketkeeper Ghazi Ghori. Ghori was dismissed for 48 by Dilshan Madushanka, while Shakeel went on to anchor the innings with a score of 93 off 199 balls before falling to Asitha Fernando. Another debutant, Arafat Minhas, added a half-century by scoring 52 runs from 67 deliveries before also falling to Madushanka.

Fernando and Madushanka finished the innings with three wickets apiece for Sri Lanka, while Lahiru Kumara, Milan Rathnayake, and Sonal Dinusha each claimed one wicket. As play prepares to move into the third day, Pakistan aims to press their significant advantage, whereas Sri Lanka relies on their middle order to build upon the defensive resilience demonstrated by Mendis and De Silva.

stories.title: Aluminium Prices Drop to Two-Week Low Amid Higher Exports
stories.summary:
Aluminium prices experienced a downturn on Tuesday, reaching their lowest level in more than two weeks as surging export volumes from primary producer China and optimism regarding potential Middle East de-escalation alleviated supply worries. Benchmark three-month aluminium on the London Metal Exchange dropped by 1.1% to $3,031.50 per metric ton around 0950 GMT, touching a low of $3,014, which marks its weakest position since October 23. Market sentiment was further influenced by United States President Donald Trump stating on Monday that he would temporarily withhold new military strikes against Iran following regional appeals.

Official Chinese customs data revealed that the country's exports of aluminium and aluminium products grew by 18% to reach 5.9 million tons throughout the first ten months of 2026. Global aluminium prices have experienced a 20% decline since peaking at a four-year high in June. This downward shift is attributed to supply restarts in the Middle East—initially disrupted by the conflict with Iran—progressing faster than anticipated, alongside upcoming production capacity expected from Indonesia.

Analysts at ANZ noted that as metal returns from the Middle East and new projects in Indonesia ramp up, worldwide supply growth is projected to outpace demand, potentially shifting the market into a surplus by 2027. This outlook is expected to restrict major price gains next year, though lingering regional supply risks will likely maintain price volatility above $3,000 through early 2027. Providing some floor to the market, global inventories remain relatively low, with available aluminium stocks in LME-registered warehouses standing at 207,525 tons, representing their lowest figure since March 2025.

Reflecting tight immediate supply conditions, the premium of the LME cash aluminium contract over the three-month benchmark widened to $96 a ton, marking its highest level since June. Meanwhile, other metals on the London Metal Exchange showed mixed results: copper declined 0.1% to $13,876 a ton, zinc advanced 0.1% to $3,733.50, lead remained stable at $1,884.50, tin decreased 0.6% to $45,960, and nickel fell 0.7% to $16,100.

stories.title: Pakistan and US Agree to Expand Academic and Think Tank Exchanges
stories.summary:
Deputy Prime Minister and Foreign Minister Senator Ishaq Dar and former US Assistant Secretary of State for South Asian Affairs Ambassador Robin Raphel met in Islamabad on Tuesday to discuss bilateral relations and regional matters. During the meeting, both officials agreed to promote closer cooperation and dialogue between academic institutions and think tanks in Pakistan and the United States to deepen mutual understanding.

During the discussions, Dar praised the positive direction of Pakistan-US relations and emphasized the need for sustained diplomatic engagement. The meeting coincides with recent high-level diplomatic developments, including US President Donald Trump's nomination of Chargé d’Affaires Natalie A. Baker as the next US ambassador to Pakistan on Monday, which is pending Senate confirmation and would fill a vacancy left since early 2025.

Bilateral ties have undergone a notable transformation during Trump's second term, shifting from a cold period to strategic and pragmatic cooperation. This diplomatic thaw was propelled by Trump's intervention in brokering a ceasefire during the May 2025 Pakistan-India border skirmish, subsequent counterterrorism cooperation, and Pakistan's inclusion in geopolitical initiatives such as the Board of Peace.

The strengthening of ties matters for regional stability and international diplomacy, reflecting a repaired partnership between Islamabad and Washington that encompasses security collaboration, counterterrorism efforts, and enhanced institutional dialogues.

stories.title: Kylian Mbappe Focused Ahead of Upcoming Fixtures, Says Konate
stories.summary:
France captain Kylian Mbappe has moved past a challenging recent period and is entirely concentrated on assisting his national team ahead of their upcoming Nations League matches against Italy and Turkey, according to defender Ibrahima Konate. Mbappe has rejoined the French squad after missing their previous three fixtures due to an injury.

Mbappe's return to the national setup follows a period of personal and professional scrutiny, which included finishing second behind England captain Harry Kane in the voting for the Ballon d'Or award. Additionally, the 27-year-old Real Madrid forward faced criticism in China stemming from remarks made during an interview where he referenced an online meme featuring his face superimposed on an image of Mao Zedong, modern China's founding leader. The controversy led to apologies from the player, a commercial backlash that saw several brands end partnerships with him, and the removal of Spanish league matches from the schedule of state broadcaster CCTV.

Konate, who is also Mbappe's club teammate at Real Madrid, emphasized that the forward possesses a strong competitive mindset. Speaking to reporters, Konate noted that Mbappe is in a very positive frame of mind, pointing to his recent decisive performances and vital contributions for Madrid.

Addressing the disappointment regarding the Ballon d'Or, Konate acknowledged that missing out on the accolade after believing he had a chance was difficult for a competitor like Mbappe. However, Konate highlighted the player's immediate resilience and professionalism, noting that he returned to training fully focused the very next day.

stories.title: UAE Issues Rare Tender to Sell 1.7 Million Barrels of Saudi Oil
stories.summary:
The energy ministry of the United Arab Emirates is conducting a rare sale of 1.7 million barrels of Saudi Arab Light oil via a tender process, according to a document reviewed by Reuters. Industry sources indicated that the petroleum cargo is currently loaded aboard the tanker Gem No. 2.

The vessel carrying the oil was struck by an unidentified projectile last month. Following the onset of the conflict involving the United States, Israel, and Iran, commercial shipping lanes in the Gulf have faced increased attacks. These maritime security incidents have elevated risks for commercial transport and heightened widespread concerns regarding the potential environmental fallout in the region. The UAE government announced last week that an oil leak originating from the Gem No. 2 tanker had successfully been contained and stopped.

Documentation regarding the sale identifies the Ministry of Energy and Infrastructure of the UAE as the seller, operating under the judicial supervision of the UAE Federal Public Prosecution. The tender officially closed on Monday.

According to the tender specifications, the arrangement required the oil cargo to be loaded between November 10 and November 20. The transfer is scheduled to take place via a ship-to-ship operation conducted from within the waters of the Gulf.

stories.title: Imam-ul-Haq and Abdullah Shafique Score Centuries in Quaid-e-Azam Trophy Gold
stories.summary:
Centuries by Imam-ul-Haq, Abdullah Shafique, and Azeem Bari highlighted the second day of the second round of the Quaid-e-Azam Trophy Gold first-class tournament on Tuesday. At the Diamond Cricket Ground in Islamabad, Imam scored an unbeaten 137 to guide Multan to 216 in response to Karachi Blues' 214, backed by Asad Umar's bowling figures of 6-45.

At the Shoaib Akhtar Cricket Stadium in Rawalpindi, Abdullah Shafique contributed 112 runs as Sialkot Blues reached 316-9 against Faisalabad's first-innings total of 222, with support from Abdul Rehman's 53. Meanwhile, Islamabad amassed 403-6 against Lahore Whites at the Abbottabad Cricket Stadium, powered by Azeem Bari's 105, alongside strong contributions from Raja Hamza Waheed, Sudais Ulfat, and Sarmad Bhatti.

In other matches, FATA were bowled out for 230 against Peshawar Blues, who subsequently established a 140-run lead, while Shaheen Shah Afridi claimed three wickets for 36. In the Silver competition, Rawalpindi and Abbottabad secured dominant innings victories over Larkana and DMJ, respectively, driven by standout bowling performances from Mohammad Nawaz, Mohammad Nabeel, and Israr Hussain.

These matches are part of the domestic first-class cricket calendar in Pakistan, providing a competitive platform for national players and emerging talent to showcase their skills across various regional and departmental sides.

stories.title: Pakistani Rupee Edges Up Slightly Against US Dollar in Inter-Bank Market
stories.summary:
The Pakistani rupee registered a marginal gain against the US dollar in the inter-bank market on Tuesday, closing the trading session at 276.65. This marked an increase of Re0.01 compared to the previous week, when the local currency finished at 276.66 after appreciating by 0.03% from 276.75 a week earlier, according to data provided by the State Bank of Pakistan.

Internationally, the US dollar held firm during Tuesday's Asia session as traders awaited upcoming US inflation data that could influence future interest rate decisions. The dollar had experienced pressure after oil prices tumbled and stocks gained, causing investors to shift back into riskier assets.
